llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a plain-text, advice-only real estate assistant and does not request credentials or install software. Before installing: (1) review the full SKILL.md (the copy provided here was truncated) to ensure there are no hidden instructions that read files or post data to external endpoints; (2) be cautious about sharing sensitive personal or financial data (bank logins, SSNs, full account numbers) with any skill or agent—the skill may ask for numbers to give calculations but you can substitute anonymized examples; (3) remember this is informational only and not a substitute for licensed professionals (attorneys, lenders, inspectors) when signing contracts; and (4) note the publisher/source is unknown and there is no homepage—if provenance or vendor support matters to you, prefer skills with known publishers or additional reviews.
